task.description:
Design the SPT-02 data migration artefacts. SPT-02 must copy all existing tenant rows from the public schema into per-tenant schemas (via bpm_provision_tenant_schema()), then remove tenant_id columns, the bpm_effective_tenant_id() function, all RLS policies, and tenant-scoped composite indexes from public tables.

Requirements summary:
- Migration 061: for every distinct tenant_id in any affected table, call bpm_provision_tenant_schema() if schema not yet registered, then INSERT-SELECT all rows for that tenant into the corresponding tenant-schema table. Must be atomic per tenant (per-tenant transaction). Idempotent (skip already-migrated tenants via tenant_schemas registry).
- Migration 062: DROP tenant_id columns from all public tables (process_definitions, process_instances, events, tasks, timers, audit_log, tenant_hostnames, tokens, sessions). DROP bpm_effective_tenant_id() function. DROP all RLS policies on those tables. DROP tenant-id-based composite indexes.
- Migration 063: Belt-and-suspenders idempotency — DROP POLICY IF EXISTS for every previously known policy on every affected table.

Classify each migration per lego-catalog.md (Type C — migration + test). Produce templates/specs/spt-02-migration-061.migration.yaml, templates/specs/spt-02-migration-062.migration.yaml, templates/specs/spt-02-migration-063.migration.yaml, and a prose design src/design/spt-02.md covering error taxonomy, rollback strategy, and data-integrity invariants.

Tables affected: process_definitions, process_instances, events, tasks, timers, audit_log, tenant_hostnames, tokens, sessions (any table with tenant_id NOT NULL as of migration 060 baseline).
acceptance_criteria: Three migration YAML specs exist at templates/specs/spt-02-migration-06{1,2,3}.migration.yaml
src/design/spt-02.md covers all SPT-02 acceptance criteria from requirements doc
Error taxonomy defined: what happens on duplicate rows, missing schema, interrupted copy
Rollback strategy documented (only possible before SPT-03)
No implementation code in prose design

result.summary: Design for SPT-02 data migration — types: [C, C, C, E]. Three migration YAML specs produced (061 copy rows, 062 drop RLS/columns, 063 idempotency cleanup) plus prose design. All codegen dry-runs exit 0; lint 0 BLOCKERs 0 MAJORs. Key open questions documented: tenant_hostnames scope, users/groups copy decision, FK insert order, table name discrepancy (process_instances vs instance_projections).

issues.description: Requirement doc names 'process_instances', 'timers', 'sessions' as affected tables; actual DB tables are 'instance_projections' (no tenant_id on timers or sessions found in migrations). Design uses actual table names and flags this for BACKEND-DEV verification.
tenant_hostnames has tenant_id as an FK, not an RLS isolation column. Recommended to leave in public schema; BACKEND-DEV must confirm.
users/groups tables have tenant_id but no RLS policies and are not in requirement explicit list. Design recommends copying to tenant schemas; BACKEND-DEV must confirm.
